def prover_commit_reference.material_padding_owned
  (hash : Slice (Slice Std.U8) → Result (Array Std.U8 32#usize))
  (domain : Slice Std.U8) (state : prover_commit_reference.State)
  (values : alloc.vec.Vec aspis_core.field.QM31) (row : Std.Usize)
  (dependent : Std.Usize) (active : Array Bool 1024#usize) :
  Result ((core.result.Result Unit state_only_hiding.StateOnlyMaskBuildError)
    × (alloc.vec.Vec aspis_core.field.QM31) × prover_commit_reference.State)
  := do
  if row >= 1024#usize
  then ok (core.result.Result.Ok (), values, state)
  else
    let b ← Array.index_usize active row
    if b
    then
      let i ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add row 1#usize)
      prover_commit_reference.material_padding_owned hash domain state values i
        dependent active
    else
      if row != dependent
      then
        let (sample, state1) ←
          prover_commit_reference.qm31_caller hash domain state
        match sample with
        | core.result.Result.Ok value =>
          let (_, index_mut_back) ←
            alloc.vec.Vec.index_mut (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice
              aspis_core.field.QM31) values row
          let values1 := index_mut_back value
          let i ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add row 1#usize)
          prover_commit_reference.material_padding_owned hash domain state1
            values1 i dependent active
        | core.result.Result.Err error =>
          ok (core.result.Result.Err error, values, state1)
      else
        let i ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add row 1#usize)
        prover_commit_reference.material_padding_owned hash domain state values
          i dependent active

def prover_commit_reference.assemble_owned17
  (hash : Slice (Slice Std.U8) → Result (Array Std.U8 32#usize))
  (domain : Slice Std.U8) (state : prover_commit_reference.State)
  (cells : Std.Usize) (c1 : alloc.vec.Vec aspis_core.field.M31)
  (columns : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec aspis_core.field.M31))
  (g : alloc.vec.Vec aspis_core.field.QM31)
  (padding : alloc.vec.Vec aspis_core.field.QM31) (dependent : Std.Usize)
  (active : Array Bool 1024#usize) (nonce : Array Std.U8 32#usize) :
  Result ((core.result.Result prover_commit_reference.OwnedMaterial17
    state_only_hiding.StateOnlyMaskBuildError) ×
    prover_commit_reference.State)
  := do
  let (status, c11, after_c1) ←
    prover_commit_reference.collect_m31_owned hash domain state cells c1
  match status with
  | core.result.Result.Ok _ =>
    let (status1, columns1, after_columns) ←
      prover_commit_reference.material_columns_owned hash domain after_c1
        columns 0#usize 10#usize dependent active
    match status1 with
    | core.result.Result.Ok _ =>
      let (status2, g1, after_g) ←
        prover_commit_reference.collect_qm31_owned hash domain after_columns
          1024#usize g
      match status2 with
      | core.result.Result.Ok _ =>
        let (status3, g2) ←
          prover_commit_reference.balance_qm31_owned g1 dependent active
        match status3 with
        | core.result.Result.Ok _ =>
          let (status4, padding1, final_state) ←
            prover_commit_reference.material_padding_owned hash domain after_g
              padding 0#usize dependent active
          match status4 with
          | core.result.Result.Ok _ =>
            let (status5, padding2) ←
              prover_commit_reference.balance_qm31_owned padding1 dependent
                active
            match status5 with
            | core.result.Result.Ok _ =>
              ok (core.result.Result.Ok
                {
                  c1 := c11,
                  columns := columns1,
                  g := g2,
                  padding := padding2,
                  nonce
                }, final_state)
            | core.result.Result.Err e =>
              ok (core.result.Result.Err e, final_state)
          | core.result.Result.Err e =>
            ok (core.result.Result.Err e, final_state)
        | core.result.Result.Err e => ok (core.result.Result.Err e, after_g)
      | core.result.Result.Err e => ok (core.result.Result.Err e, after_g)
    | core.result.Result.Err e => ok (core.result.Result.Err e, after_columns)
  | core.result.Result.Err e => ok (core.result.Result.Err e, after_c1)
